findings.location: docs/product-spec.md §6 AC-13 (also mirrored in SPEC-AC-13.scope) — introduced by the novel-2 repair
findings.evidence: AC-13 now asserts: "未配置 AI key 时跳转配置引导页而非报错，且此时应用自身外发网络请求为 0（OM-8 隐私底线）", and SPEC-AC-13.scope: "无 key 跳配置引导而非报错且此时应用外发请求为 0（OM-8）". Both restate OM-8's consequent but drop its second conjunct — OM-8 itself requires "未配置 AI key 且 iCloud 关闭时". Read literally (app-scoped claim, keyless state), AC-13 contradicts AC-12: with no AI key but iCloud ON, CloudKit sync legitimately produces outbound traffic (required by OM-6). The "（OM-8 隐私底线）" citation makes the full condition recoverable, so this is recoverable imprecision rather than a hard blocker — but as written the clause is false in the keyless+sync-on state.
findings.suggestion: Restate AC-13's clause with OM-8's full condition ("未配置 AI key 且 iCloud 关闭时") or scope the zero-request claim to the translation flow itself.
